json_ld.name: Cross-Domain Stem Cell Delivery Breakthrough Models for Cystic Fibrosis
json_ld.description: Deterministic in silico biophysical and kinetic models establishing feasibility for apical-to-basolateral receptor transcytosis (FcRn, TfR1, pIgR), airway secretory-to-basal dedifferentiation plasticity, and cross-domain delivery innovation rankings.

bfi_rankings.title: Airway Secretory-to-Basal Dedifferentiation via Transient Notch Reprogramming
bfi_rankings.mechanism: Facultative lineage plasticity: committed luminal secretory cells (SCGB1A1+) dedifferentiate into multipotent basal stem cells (KRT5+/TP63+) upon transient Notch inhibition.
bfi_rankings.cf_application: Eliminates the requirement for crossing tight junctions: edit accessible apical club cells and pulse with a transient Notch inhibitor to repopulate the basal niche.
bfi_rankings.physical_barriers: Basal niche inaccessibility; tight junction penetration requirement

bfi_rankings.title: Low-Affinity Transferrin Receptor (TfR1) Monovalent Transcytosis
bfi_rankings.mechanism: Tuning ligand binding affinity (Kd = 200-400 nM) avoids lysosomal sorting, redirecting internalized vesicles to Rab11a exocytosis pathways across tight junctions.
bfi_rankings.cf_application: Enables aerosolized nanoparticles to cross intact airway tight junctions via Rab11a-mediated basolateral exocytosis directly into the basal stem cell niche.
bfi_rankings.physical_barriers: Epithelial tight junctions; endosomal/lysosomal degradation pathway

bfi_rankings.title: Polysarcosine (pSar) Biodegradable Stealth & Ester-Cleavable Ionizable Lipids
bfi_rankings.mechanism: Replaces immunogenic PEG conjugates with non-immunogenic polysarcosine (pSar); incorporates enzymatic ester cleavable aliphatic tails (macrophage t1/2 < 4h).
bfi_rankings.cf_application: Abolishes the acute alveolar macrophage TLR7/8 cytokine storm (IL-8/TNF-alpha) and anti-PEG neutralizing antibody clearance that terminated VX-522.
bfi_rankings.physical_barriers: Polyanionic mucin adhesion; alveolar macrophage TLR7/8 activation and PEG clearance

bfi_rankings.title: CendR / NRP-1 Proteolytic Internalization & Mucinase Liquefaction
bfi_rankings.mechanism: iRGD / C-end Rule peptide activation of Neuropilin-1 (NRP-1) macropinocytosis coupled with StcE mucin-cleaving protease (Malaker et al. PNAS 2019, DOI: 10.1073/pnas.1813020116).
bfi_rankings.cf_application: Enzymatically liquefies thick CF sputum meshwork while actively triggering trans-epithelial penetration across apical ciliated and secretory cells.
bfi_rankings.physical_barriers: Sputum mucin meshwork steric entrapment; apical endocytic barrier

bfi_rankings.title: Sendai Virus F/HN Pseudotyped Enveloped Delivery Vehicles (EDVs)
bfi_rankings.mechanism: Hemagglutinin-neuraminidase (HN) binds apical sialic acid; fusion (F) protein mediates direct pH-independent membrane fusion at the apical plasma membrane.
bfi_rankings.cf_application: Bypasses endosomal TLR pattern recognition entirely by directly injecting Cas9/prime-editor RNPs across the luminal membrane at neutral pH.
bfi_rankings.physical_barriers: Mucosal endosomal entrapment; lysosomal TLR pattern recognition
